title: The original Molcajete Mexicano volcanic rock Handmade of Authentic Lava Rock in Mexico - Molcajete de Piedra volcanica - Molcajete Mortar Pestle molcajete bowl molcajete volcanic rock guacamole maker
description:
About this item
AUTHENTIC LAVA ROCK - This molcajete is made of authentinc lava rock from the Popocatepetl Volcan in Puebla México. It is made for mexican artisans.
WHAT INCLUDES - It includes a 8 inches mortar with a pestle and one Traditional tortilla warmer just like our mom or grandma have in their kitchen.
HOW TO CURE YOUR MOLCAJETE - We will send you my email (Be sure to check your email) a step by step guide about how to cure your molcajete like the mexican traditional way.
MADE IN MEXICO - With your purchase you are supporting a community of mexican artisans. All our molcajetes are made in Mexico.
MEASUREMENTS - Diameter 8.0 inches, height 5.0 inches, all measurements may vary, remember this is a handmade product. Weight 7.0 to 8.8 pounds, it is heavy because it is made of authentic lava stones.
reviews_5s:
Day 1 and 2, seasoned the molcajete using rice and then rice and salt for a total of 5 hours of seasoning. I jumped straight into making some traditional salsa….I couldn’t be happier with the end result.

For those who’ve never used a molcajete to prepare food before (like me), the seasoning process really gets you in shape to take any recipe on! Gave fun with this authentic, old school cooking tool.These things need a lot of work to get to use. Not that I minded, but damn! First: you will need to use coarse salt and Jasmine rice to season it over a period of a few half hours. Secondly: You will need to make sure to check all the powdered rice flour you make to not have any volcanic rock fragments in it, anymore. Lastly: You will have to make sure all of the interior of the Molcajete is as smooth as you can get it. Is it worth it? OH HELL YES! It is time well spent! DO NOT use liquid soap at the start! Soap can get caught in the molcajete and affect the taste of the food in terrible ways. If you use soap, all your food will taste soapy, and no one wants that! The surface is porous and will absorb that crap! Might as well put your cast iron pots and pans in the dishwasher.

Lastly use a combo of rock salt, Cilantro, Cumin seed, garlic cloves, and habaneros to the bowl and mash them and let them rest and cook them to retain flavors in the molcajete. Later, rinse them out. Trust me! the porous stone will hold on to these flavors and add to the salsas you make in it! OMG! Do this only once and you will have awesome game night meals forever! It's work that will pay off in the long run! Enjoy. reviews_1s:
The molcajete bowl arrived in great shape along with a tortilla warmer, but no pestle. That makes this not useful.

Some reviews said the lava was too porous and yes this one has some porous lava holes, but nothing extraordinarily large. I know when I work on smoothing the bowl (if I had the pestle), the surface would smooth out. The bowl depth is just fine for making salsas.

If and when I get the pestle, I’ll rate this better. For now it is a 1 star.
2 stars for easy to clean, because molcajetes need to be smoothed and then seasoned between uses.
3 stars for sturdiness, but I wouldn’t drop it.
1 star for gif table because it’s missing the pestle and useless without one.The product itself is OK and kind of interesting. However it came without the tortilla warmer and the pestle, so basically it is a bowl. It also took two weeks to arrive after Amazon changing my arrival date and time multiple times after failing to meet the expected previous date/times. I told them I didn’t want the item, but they delivered it anyway. The Amazin agent told me i would be refunded and I didn’t have to return it. Well, now in the Amazon app it says it has been refunded, but I do need to return it. The time and hassle spent on this has been significant and really unacceptable.
